Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4716-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

4499-7494-7729.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {2}{R}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

4934-5078-7693.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2762-5231-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Thopter Squadron to make creature tokens.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

Repeat from step 3.

When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.

When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.

Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

729-2034-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Oak Guardian.
When the Great Oak Guardian token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Great Oak Guardian token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4659-5003-6258-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4659-5003-6258-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

372-2072-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2072-4823.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1799-5296-6005.manaNeeded: {4} minus {1} for each +1/+1 counter on Workhorse
1799-5296-6005.description:

Repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Food.
856-1201-1651-5776.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Cauldron Familiar, as it is a Food due to Ygra, and another Food, targeting Witch's Oven.
Holding priority, activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a tapped Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1770-2226-5125.manaNeeded: {2} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1770-2226-5125.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-5125.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}{G}{W}.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying {2}{R}{G}.
When Sparkcaster enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sparkcaster triggers, returning itself and Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Sparkcaster triggers, dealing 2 damage to target player or planeswalker.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's other abilities.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Sparkcaster by paying its mana cost.
When Sparkcaster enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1950-2034-2876-3374.notablePrerequisites: Elenda does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1950-2034-2876-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Elenda persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elenda, adding {C}{C}.
Elenda dies, triggering its second ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the second Elenda trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Vampire creature tokens equal to Elenda's power.
Resolve Elenda's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Vampire token, adding {C}{C}.
The Vampire dies, triggering Elenda's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
